profile_text.body:
OpenAI is a for-profit AI company founded in 2015 and headquartered in San Francisco, California. Its primary public-facing product is ChatGPT, which the company's website describes as a tool to "answer questions, write, create images, complete work, and code," available via browser or app with a free entry tier. The site notes that chats may be reviewed and used to improve OpenAI's AI models.

Beyond ChatGPT, OpenAI offers a range of AI products including the OpenAI API and GPT models for developers, an OpenAI Playground and Dashboard for API testing and fine-tuning, DALL-E for image generation, Sora for video generation, and the Whisper API for speech recognition, transcription, and translation. The company also offers Operator, described as an autonomous web agent with browser control capabilities. These products span chat, coding tools, image and video generation, and voice and audio processing.

OpenAI is named in a substantial number of active legal proceedings. Cases on record include wikiHow, Inc. v. OpenAI, Inc. in the Southern District of New York, two actions captioned United States v. OpenAI OpCo LLC in the Eastern District of Arkansas, Haugland v. OpenAI, Inc. in the District of Hawaii, X.AI Corp. et al. v. OpenAI, Inc. et al. before the Ninth Circuit, and several matters in Florida and California courts including actions brought by the Florida Office of the Attorney General against OpenAI Global, LLC. The company also has a registered presence in the MCP server registry.
